description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different methods in relation extraction, measured by Micro F1 score, as a function of the number of samples generated. The x-axis represents the number of samples generated, with values K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64. The y-axis measures the Micro F1 score in percentage, ranging from approximately 25% to 52%. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different method: TACRED (blue line with circle markers), TACRED-Revisit (orange line with triangle markers), Re-TACRED (green line with diamond markers), and SemEval (red line with star markers). The TACRED line shows a steady increase in performance as the number of samples increases, starting at around 25% and reaching approximately 30% at K=64. The TACRED-Revisit line also shows an increase, starting at around 25% and reaching about 30% at K=64. The Re-TACRED line starts at around 35% and peaks at approximately 51% at K=32 before slightly declining to about 48% at K=64. The SemEval line starts at around 45% and shows a steady increase, reaching about 52% at K=64.
